field_evidence.dataset_title: MPS Violence Against Women and Girls dashboard data
field_evidence.description: Aggregated VAWG dashboard data. Offence-based Location data and victim-based Location data are published by BCU, borough and ward.
field_evidence.aggregation_note: Published in aggregated form to reduce disclosure risk and protect individuals.

records.evidence_slice: London Datastore publishes the official Metropolitan Police Service Violence Against Women and Girls dashboard data. The offence-based dataset includes a Location worksheet aggregated by BCU, borough and ward; the victim-based dataset also includes a Location worksheet with victim counts by BCU, borough and ward. The published files cover January 2014 through April 2026 under Open Government Licence v2. This batch binds Campden as the target ward, retaining verified ward code E05009390 as the crosswalk key; ward-row extraction, parcel spatial join and materialization are deferred to local OpenCode, so no VAWG row values or parcel progress are claimed.
